description:
There‘s a different version of this track with a slighty more complex drum pattern in SMT if... known as 'Chi no Nomos‘.
You can switch between the SMT 2 and SMT if… versions with:
set define to #define Version 0, to get the SMT 2 version
Set define to #define Version 1, to get the SMT if... version
